admin-attendees.checkin.absent.description: Check-in panel of an attendee who has not checked in.

admin-attendees.checkin.alreadyPresent.defaultMessage: O check-in já havia sido realizado.
admin-attendees.checkin.alreadyPresent.description: Toast on the record's page when marking found the attendee already checked in.

admin-attendees.checkin.at.description: When the attendee checked in. {time} is the event-timezone date and time, already formatted.

admin-attendees.checkin.confirm.description: Label of the armed check-in button: a second press checks the attendee in and draws an arrival number that cannot be taken back. Reverts after a few seconds.

admin-attendees.checkin.failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível confirmar o check-in. Tente novamente.
admin-attendees.checkin.failed.description: Error line when confirming the check-in failed for a reason the server did not explain.

admin-attendees.checkin.forbidden.defaultMessage: Você não tem mais permissão para confirmar o check-in.
admin-attendees.checkin.forbidden.description: Error line when the operator's check-in permission was withdrawn while the record was open.

admin-attendees.checkin.heading.description: Heading of the panel showing the record's check-in status.

admin-attendees.checkin.mark.description: Button that checks the attendee in without the QR. The first press arms it and admin-attendees.checkin.confirm replaces this label.

admin-attendees.checkin.markHint.defaultMessage: Confirme o check-in de um participante manualmente. Use apenas se você estiver junto com o participante e ele não puder realizar a confirmação de presença (QR Code). O número de check-in será gerado automaticamente após a confirmação.
admin-attendees.checkin.markHint.description: Hint under the check-in button, explaining it stands in for the QR scan and verification code, and that a participant is issued the next arrival number, which cannot be taken back. Volunteers are not issued one.

admin-attendees.checkin.marked.description: Toast on the record's page after the operator checked the attendee in by hand.

admin-attendees.checkin.notOpen.defaultMessage: O check-in ainda não abriu para este público.
admin-attendees.checkin.notOpen.description: Error line when check-in has not opened yet for the attendee's audience.

admin-attendees.checkin.number.description: Presence of an attendee who checked in and holds arrival number {number}.

admin-attendees.checkin.readOnly.defaultMessage: Sua conta não tem permissão para confirmar o check-in.
admin-attendees.checkin.readOnly.description: Replaces the check-in button for an operator without the check-in permission.

admin-attendees.checkin.unsaved.defaultMessage: Salve ou descarte as alterações ao formulário antes de confirmar o check-in.
admin-attendees.checkin.unsaved.description: Error line when the check-in button is pressed while the form holds unsaved edits, which opening the record again would discard.

admin-attendees.danger.archive.description: Archive button. The first press arms it and admin-attendees.danger.confirm replaces this label.

admin-attendees.danger.archiveHint.defaultMessage: Arquive o participante para bloquear o acesso ao check-in e ao app. O participante pode ser restaurado por esta mesma tela.
admin-attendees.danger.archiveHint.description: Explains archiving before the operator presses it.

admin-attendees.danger.archived.description: Toast on the record's page after it was archived.

admin-attendees.danger.confirm.description: Label of the armed archive button: a second press archives. Reverts after a few seconds.

admin-attendees.danger.heading.description: Heading of the panel holding the archive control.

admin-attendees.danger.restore.description: Restore button on an archived record. Acts on the first press.

admin-attendees.danger.restoreHint.defaultMessage: Restaure o participante para liberar acesso ao check-in e ao app
admin-attendees.danger.restoreHint.description: Explains restoring on an archived record.

admin-attendees.danger.restored.description: Toast on the record's page after it was restored from the archive.

admin-attendees.form.actionFailed.description: Error line when archiving or restoring failed for a reason the server did not explain.

admin-attendees.form.archivedFlag.defaultMessage: Este participante está arquivado: não é possível realizar o check-in, visualizar o ingresso nem participar das interações.
admin-attendees.form.archivedFlag.description: Banner on an archived record, naming everything archiving takes away.

admin-attendees.form.cancel.description: Link back to the roster without saving.

admin-attendees.form.close.defaultMessage: Voltar para a lista de participantes
admin-attendees.form.close.description: Accessible name of the record's close button.

admin-attendees.form.create.description: Save button on the blank form.

admin-attendees.form.created.description: Toast on the new record's page after the blank form was saved.

admin-attendees.form.forbidden.defaultMessage: Você não tem mais permissão para editar participantes.
admin-attendees.form.forbidden.description: Error line when the operator's edit permission was withdrawn while the form was open.

admin-attendees.form.itemNone.description: First choice in an enabled item's dropdown: the attendee does not receive the item.

admin-attendees.form.itemOffList.description: Dropdown choice for a stored value that is not on the approved list, usually from the imported roster. {value} is the value exactly as stored. Choosing another option replaces it for good.

admin-attendees.form.itemUnavailable.description: First choice in a volunteer-only item's dropdown while the record is not a volunteer; the dropdown is disabled.

admin-attendees.form.items.description: Heading of the group of redeemable items (t-shirt sizes, meal, drink and lunch choice).

admin-attendees.form.itemsHint.defaultMessage: "Nenhum" significa que o participante não recebe o item.

admin-attendees.form.phoneHint.defaultMessage: Com DDD, entre 10 e 11 dígitos. Número de outro país: comece com + e o código do país (ex.: +44 7911 123456). Os últimos quatro dígitos são o código de verificação no check-in.
admin-attendees.form.phoneHint.description: Hint under the phone field. A leading + marks a foreign number with its country code; the last four digits are the check-in verification code, which is why a typo matters.

admin-attendees.form.readOnly.defaultMessage: Você não tem permissão para editar participantes.
admin-attendees.form.readOnly.description: Replaces the save button for an operator who may read but not edit.

admin-attendees.form.redeemed.description: Tag beside an item that was already collected. Lowercase: it trails the item's name.

admin-attendees.form.roleLocked.defaultMessage: O tipo de ingresso não pode ser mudado depois que a check-in foi confirmado.
admin-attendees.form.roleLocked.description: Hint under the role of an attendee who has checked in, whose role can no longer change.

admin-attendees.form.save.description: Save button on an existing record.

admin-attendees.form.saveFailed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível salvar. Tente novamente.
admin-attendees.form.saveFailed.description: Error line when a save or a nickname removal failed for a reason the server did not explain.

admin-attendees.form.saved.description: Toast after an existing record was saved.

admin-attendees.form.ticketCodeEdit.description: Accessible name of the pencil button that unlocks the ticket code field on the blank form, for typing a code from the external sign-up system.

admin-attendees.form.ticketCodeHint.afte.description: Last piece of the ticket code hint, after VXXXXX. See admin-attendees.form.ticketCodeHint.before.

admin-attendees.form.ticketCodeHint.befo.defaultMessage: O código é gerado automaticamente pelo sistema:
admin-attendees.form.ticketCodeHint.befo.description: First of three pieces of the ticket code hint, around the code formats DXXXXX and VXXXXX, which are rendered as code between them: "O código é gerado automaticamente pelo sistema: DXXXXX (participantes) ou VXXXXX para voluntários."

admin-attendees.form.ticketCodeHint.betw.description: Second piece of the ticket code hint, between DXXXXX and VXXXXX. See admin-attendees.form.ticketCodeHint.before.

admin-attendees.form.ticketCodeLocked.defaultMessage: O código de ingresso não pode ser alterado depois que o participante foi cadastrado. Para alterar o ingresso, arquive este participante e crie um novo.
admin-attendees.form.ticketCodeLocked.description: Hint under an existing record's read-only ticket code.

admin-attendees.form.ticketCodePlacehold.description: Placeholder of the ticket code field on the blank form, which is locked until its pencil button is pressed.

admin-attendees.form.tshirtEdit.description: Accessible name of the pencil button that unlocks the participant t-shirt size, which the attendee reserved in advance.

admin-attendees.form.tshirtReservedHint.defaultMessage: Reservada antecipadamente pelo participante. Toque no lápis para alterar.
admin-attendees.form.tshirtReservedHint.description: Hint under the locked participant t-shirt size.

admin-attendees.form.volunteersOnly.description: Hint under a volunteer-only item's dropdown (volunteer t-shirt, lunch) while the record is a participant, when the dropdown is disabled. Only volunteers can be entitled to these items.

admin-attendees.list.archivedFilter.description: Label of the roster's archive filter.

admin-attendees.list.archivedFlag.description: Tag beside an archived attendee's name. Lowercase: it trails the name.

admin-attendees.list.clearFilters.description: Link after admin-attendees.list.noMatches that resets every filter.

admin-attendees.list.count.description: Result count above the roster. {total} is the number of matching records; filtered is yes while a filter is set. The suffix does not agree in number with a single result.

admin-attendees.list.createFirst.description: Link after admin-attendees.list.empty to the blank record form, for operators who may edit.

admin-attendees.list.drawsFlag.description: Tag beside a volunteer who may run the raffle. Lowercase: it trails the role badge.

admin-attendees.list.empty.description: Empty roster with no filter set: the event has no attendees yet.

admin-attendees.list.items.description: Roster column: the items the attendee is entitled to, and whether each was collected.

admin-attendees.list.name.description: Roster column: the attendee's name and nickname.

admin-attendees.list.noMatches.defaultMessage: Nenhum participante corresponde a esses filtros.
admin-attendees.list.noMatches.description: Empty roster while a filter is set. Followed by admin-attendees.list.clearFilters.

admin-attendees.list.phone.description: Roster column: the phone number, masked.

admin-attendees.list.redeemsFlag.description: Tag beside a volunteer who may record redemptions. Lowercase: it trails the role badge.

admin-attendees.newAttendee.description: Heading of the blank record form, and the roster link that opens it.

admin-attendees.nickname.heading.description: Heading of the record's nickname panel.

admin-attendees.nickname.hint.defaultMessage: O apelido é definido pelo próprio participante.
admin-attendees.nickname.hint.description: Hint under a nickname: staff may clear it but never set one.

admin-attendees.nickname.none.description: Shown when the attendee has not chosen a nickname.

admin-attendees.nickname.remove.description: Button that clears the attendee's nickname.

admin-attendees.nickname.removed.description: Toast on the record's page after the staff removed the attendee's nickname.

admin-attendees.perms.draws.description: The volunteer may run the raffle.

admin-attendees.perms.heading.description: Heading of the read-only panel listing what a volunteer may do.

admin-attendees.perms.hint.description: Hint under the volunteer permissions: they are changed in the database, not here.

admin-attendees.perms.noDraws.description: The volunteer may not run the raffle.

admin-attendees.perms.noRedeems.description: The volunteer may not record redemptions.

admin-attendees.perms.stations.description: The items a volunteer may record. {stations} is the list of item keys as stored, joined with commas.

admin-attendees.roleLabel.description: Label of an attendee's role (participant or volunteer): a roster filter, a column and a form field.

admin-attendees.form.whatsapp.defaultMessage: Enviar o link do ingresso por WhatsApp
admin-attendees.form.whatsapp.description: Checkbox label on the blank form: send the door WhatsApp template to the new attendee.

admin-attendees.form.whatsappHint.description: Hint under the WhatsApp checkbox on the blank form. Reminds the operator that every message costs money and when to untick it.

admin-attendees.form.whatsappUnavailable.defaultMessage: {reason, select, switchedOff {O envio por WhatsApp foi desativado pela coordenação.} overBudget {O limite de orçamento foi atingido.} other {O envio por WhatsApp está indisponível.}}
admin-attendees.form.whatsappUnavailable.description: Hint under the disabled WhatsApp checkbox on the blank form, saying why it cannot be ticked. `reason` is a code: switchedOff or overBudget.

admin-attendees.form.createdWhatsappSent.defaultMessage: Participante cadastrado e ingresso enviado por WhatsApp.
admin-attendees.form.createdWhatsappSent.description: Success toast on the new record's page when the door WhatsApp message was accepted by Meta.

admin-attendees.form.createdWhatsappFail.defaultMessage: Participante cadastrado com sucesso, mas não foi possível enviar o ingresso por WhatsApp. Informe o código do ingresso ao participante para digitação na tela de check-in.
admin-attendees.form.createdWhatsappFail.description: Warning toast on the new record's page when the door WhatsApp message was attempted and did not go out.

admin-attendees.form.createdWhatsappSkip.defaultMessage: O participante foi cadastrado sem envio do ingresso por WhatsApp: {reason, select, lockedByEnv {indisponível} switchedOff {desativado} overBudget {limite de orçamento atingido} phoneInvalid {n° de WhatsApp inválido} rateLimited {o limite de envios deste login foi atingido, tente novamente em alguns minutos} alreadySent {a mensagem já foi enviada para esse número} attendeeCapReached {mensagens não podem mais ser enviados (limite do participante atingido)} attendeeUnavailable {o ingresso está desativado} other {o envio de mensagens está indisponível}}. admin-attendees.door.intro.defaultMessage: Envio automático de novos ingressos por WhatsApp.
admin-attendees.door.intro.description: Explanation at the top of the door WhatsApp panel on the roster.

admin-attendees.door.spend.defaultMessage: Orçamento usado: {spent, number, ::currency/USD .00##} de {budget, number, ::currency/USD .00##} ({price, number, ::currency/USD .00##} por mensagem)
admin-attendees.door.spend.description: Spend line in the door WhatsApp panel: every message Meta accepted this event, the budget, and the price of one door message.

admin-attendees.door.locked.defaultMessage: O envio de ingressos por WhatsApp está indisponível.
admin-attendees.door.locked.description: Shown in the door WhatsApp panel when WHATSAPP_DOOR_ENABLED or WHATSAPP_ENABLED is false in .env.

admin-attendees.door.overBudget.defaultMessage: O limite de orçamento definido foi atingido: o envio de mensagens foi desativado.
admin-attendees.door.overBudget.description: Shown in the door WhatsApp panel when the next message would pass the budget.

admin-attendees.door.turnOn.description: Button in the door WhatsApp panel that switches the message on.

admin-attendees.door.turnOff.description: Button in the door WhatsApp panel that switches the message off.

admin-attendees.door.saved.defaultMessage: {on, select, yes {Envio por WhatsApp ativado.} no {Envio por WhatsApp desativado.} other {Envio por WhatsApp desativado.}}
admin-attendees.door.saved.description: Success toast after the door WhatsApp switch was flipped. `on` is yes or no.

admin-attendees.door.failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível ativar o envio por WhatsApp. Tente novamente.
admin-attendees.door.failed.description: Error line in the door WhatsApp panel when flipping the switch failed.

admin-attendees.door.forbidden.defaultMessage: Você não tem mais permissão para alterar o envio por WhatsApp.
admin-attendees.door.forbidden.description: Error line in the door WhatsApp panel when the operator's whatsapp:send permission was withdrawn.

admin-attendees.form.whatsappEditHint.defaultMessage: Selecionar apenas se o telefone cadastrado foi alterado.
admin-attendees.form.whatsappEditHint.description: Hint under the WhatsApp checkbox on an existing record: it ticks itself when the phone number is changed, each number gets the message at most once, and every message costs money.

admin-attendees.form.savedWhatsappSent.defaultMessage: Alterações salvas e ingresso enviado por WhatsApp.
admin-attendees.form.savedWhatsappSent.description: Success toast after saving a record when the door WhatsApp message was accepted by Meta.

admin-attendees.form.savedWhatsappFailed.defaultMessage: Alterações salvas com sucesso, mas não foi possível enviar o link atualizado por WhatsApp. Informe o código do ingresso ao participante para digitação na tela de check-in.
admin-attendees.form.savedWhatsappFailed.description: Warning toast after saving a record when the door WhatsApp message was attempted and did not go out.

admin-attendees.form.savedWhatsappSkippe.defaultMessage: Alterações salvas sem envio do link por WhatsApp: {reason, select, lockedByEnv {indisponível} switchedOff {desativado} overBudget {limite de orçamento atingido} phoneInvalid {n° de WhatsApp inválido} rateLimited {o limite de envios deste login foi atingido, tente novamente em alguns minutos} alreadySent {a mensagem já foi enviada para esse número} attendeeCapReached {mensagens não podem mais ser enviados (limite do participante atingido)} attendeeUnavailable {o ingresso está desativado} other {o envio de mensagens está indisponível}}. Informe o código do ingresso diretamente para o participante.
admin-attendees.form.savedWhatsappSkippe.description: Notice toast after saving a record when the operator asked for the door WhatsApp message and it was not sent. `reason` is a code.

admin-attendees.limit.heading.description: Heading of the roster panel that caps how many participant tickets the editor can issue.

admin-attendees.limit.status.defaultMessage: {status, select, off {Sem limite} ok {Dentro do limite} near {Quase no limite} reached {Limite atingido} over {Limite excedido} other {Sem limite}}
admin-attendees.limit.status.description: Status pill of the ticket limit panel. `status` is a code: off, ok (below 90% of the cap), near (90% or more), reached (at the cap) or over (above it).

admin-attendees.limit.off.description: Line in the ticket limit panel when the limit is switched off.

admin-attendees.limit.usage.description: Usage line of the ticket limit panel and the form banner: tickets counted, the cap, and a detail string saying how many are left or over. `detail` is already translated.

admin-attendees.limit.left.defaultMessage: {scope, select, door {{remaining, plural, =0 {nenhum ingresso da porta restante} one {# ingresso da porta restante} other {# ingressos da porta restantes}}} total {{remaining, plural, =0 {nenhum ingresso restante} one {# ingresso restante} other {# ingressos restantes}}} other {{remaining, plural, =0 {nenhum ingresso restante} one {# ingresso restante} other {# ingressos restantes}}}}
admin-attendees.limit.left.description: How many tickets are left under the limit. `scope` is total or door (door counts only tickets generated at the door); `remaining` is a number, never negative.

admin-attendees.limit.over.defaultMessage: {scope, select, door {{excess, plural, one {# ingresso da porta acima do limite} other {# ingressos da porta acima do limite}}} total {{excess, plural, one {# ingresso acima do limite} other {# ingressos acima do limite}}} other {{excess, plural, one {# ingresso acima do limite} other {# ingressos acima do limite}}}}
admin-attendees.limit.over.description: How many tickets are above the limit. `scope` is total or door; `excess` is a positive number.

admin-attendees.limit.meterText.description: Spoken value of the ticket limit meter for screen readers, such as "38 de 50, 12 ingressos restantes". `detail` is already translated.

admin-attendees.limit.meterLabel.description: Accessible name of the ticket limit meter bar.

admin-attendees.limit.mode.description: Badge saying what reaching the ticket limit does. `mode` is hard (refuses new tickets) or warn (only warns).

admin-attendees.limit.doorHint.defaultMessage: Ingressos cadastrados com um código digitado à mão não entram na contagem.
admin-attendees.limit.doorHint.description: Hint in the ticket limit panel when only door-generated tickets are counted: a ticket whose code the operator typed is not counted.

admin-attendees.limit.edit.description: Button that reveals the ticket limit form in the roster panel.

admin-attendees.limit.save.description: Button that saves the ticket limit.

admin-attendees.limit.cancel.description: Button that closes the ticket limit form without saving.

admin-attendees.limit.scopeLegend.defaultMessage: O que conta para o limite
admin-attendees.limit.scopeLegend.description: Legend of the radio group choosing what the ticket limit counts.

admin-attendees.limit.scopeOption.defaultMessage: {scope, select, off {Sem limite} total {Todos os participantes} door {Somente ingressos gerados na porta} other {Sem limite}}
admin-attendees.limit.scopeOption.description: Radio labels for what the ticket limit counts. `scope` is off (no limit), total (every participant) or door (only tickets generated by the editor).

admin-attendees.limit.capLabel.description: Label of the number field holding the ticket limit.

admin-attendees.limit.capHint.defaultMessage: Número inteiro de {min, number} a {max, number}.
admin-attendees.limit.capHint.description: Hint under the ticket limit field. `min` and `max` are the smallest and largest cap.

admin-attendees.limit.modeLegend.description: Legend of the radio group choosing what happens when the ticket limit is reached.

admin-attendees.limit.modeOption.defaultMessage: {mode, select, hard {Bloqueio: impede novos ingressos} warn {Somente aviso: permite cadastrar e avisa} other {Bloqueio: impede novos ingressos}}
admin-attendees.limit.modeOption.description: Radio labels for what reaching the ticket limit does. `mode` is hard (refuses) or warn (allows and warns).

admin-attendees.limit.saved.description: Success toast after the ticket limit was saved.

admin-attendees.limit.failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível salvar o limite de ingressos. Tente novamente.
admin-attendees.limit.failed.description: Error line in the ticket limit panel when saving failed for a reason the server did not name.

admin-attendees.limit.forbidden.defaultMessage: Você não tem mais permissão para alterar o limite de ingressos.
admin-attendees.limit.forbidden.description: Error line in the ticket limit panel when the operator's attendees:limit permission was withdrawn.

admin-attendees.limit.formBlocked.defaultMessage: O limite de ingressos foi atingido: não é possível cadastrar novos participantes.
admin-attendees.limit.formBlocked.description: Banner text on the new attendee form when a hard ticket limit has no room left, so creating a participant is blocked.

admin-attendees.limit.formRestoreBlocked.defaultMessage: O limite de ingressos foi atingido: não é possível restaurar este participante.
admin-attendees.limit.formRestoreBlocked.description: Banner text on an archived attendee's page when a hard ticket limit has no room left, so restoring is blocked.

admin-attendees.limit.exceeded.defaultMessage: Limite de ingressos excedido ({used, number} / {cap, number}).
admin-attendees.limit.exceeded.description: Warning after creating or restoring a participant in warn mode when the ticket limit is reached or exceeded. Shown alone or following the confirmation in the same toast, so it is written as a sentence of its own. `used` and `cap` are numbers.
